Dick Cheney reveals that
he had the wireless
function of his implanted
defibrillator disabled out of
fear that terrorists would hack
into it and kill him. He has
suffered from heart disease
for decades.

content.html:
The Uruguayan government's
drug tsar Julio Calzada tells
newspaper EI Pais that legal
marijuana will be sold in
the country for $1 per
gram. According to Calzada, a
state-regulated marijuana
market would offer "a safe
place to buy a quality product,"
and would help reduce crime.

The Uruguayan government's
drug tsar Julio Calzada tells
newspaper EI Pais that legal
marijuana will be sold in
the country for $1 per
gram. According to Calzada, a
state-regulated marijuana
market would offer "a safe
place to buy a quality product,"
and would help reduce crime.

content.html:
Six people are killed and more
than 30 are injured in a
suicide bombing on a bus
in Volgograd in southern
Russia. The head of Russia's
Investigative Committee claims
that the explosives were set off
by a 30-year-old woman from
the republic of Dagestan in the
North Caucasus.
